svg.title: openmeet-core: component health, latency, privacy rules, provider info (types.rs)

g.text: openmeet-core: component health, latency, privacy rules, provider info (types.rs)
AudioToTranscript: end of speech -> final transcript
DetectionToFirstToken: request start -> first streamed token
OverlayRender: event received -> rendered (reported by the UI)
Domain: matched against browser window titles
Local: on this device (in-process or localhost)
Remote: sends data to a remote endpoint
Mock: tests / demo, never sends data
endpoint = host only, never a URL
